name: opsbrain
description: Token-cheap infrastructure operations: OpenTofu, Ansible, Kubernetes / Argo CD, hosts, router, monitoring - compact answers, raw output kept on disk, mutations only after a human approves them in a terminal.
long_description: A minimal launcher for the OpsBrain MCP server installed on this computer (`opsbrain serve`). The extension contains no logic and no credentials: OpsBrain uses the ssh-agent, kubeconfig and config file (~/.opsbrain/config.yaml) that already exist here. Approvals are given with `opsbrain approve <id>` in a terminal, never from Claude.
